# Error reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-error-reference.mjs — do not edit.
     Run `node scripts/gen-error-reference.mjs` after changing a
     handler's error code. `--check` runs in preflight. -->

Every code below is one this server actually sends on a `/v1/*`
endpoint, extracted from the handlers rather than written by hand.
The shape is always:

```json
{ "error": "<code>", "detail": "<free text, may be absent>" }
```

Branch on `error`. `detail` and `hint` are prose for a human and
change without notice.

## 401 hints

A `401` always carries `{"error":"unauthorized","hint":…}`. The hint
names which of the checks failed, in the order they run:

| `hint` | Means |
|---|---|
| <code>send `Authorization: Bearer st_<token>` header</code> | `MissingHeader` |
| <code>Authorization header must be `Bearer st_<token>`</code> | `MalformedHeader` |
| <code>token must start with `st_`</code> | `WrongPrefix` |
| <code>token starts with `st_` but is the wrong length — it was probably truncated when copied</code> | `WrongLength` |
| <code>token unknown or revoked</code> | `NotFound` |
| <code>token has wrong scope for this endpoint</code> | `KindMismatch` |

## Scope refusals come in two shapes

Both exist and they are not the same check:

- **`401` `unauthorized`** with hint `token has wrong scope for this
  endpoint` — the token middleware, before any handler runs.
- **`403` `admin_token_required`** — a handler that needs an
  `api`-scope token and was given an `ingest` one. Its hint names the
  scope to mint.

Branch on the code, not the status.

## Not error codes

`422` comes from the JSON layer before any handler runs, and its body
is plain text naming the field — `missing field \`occurredAt\``, for
instance. It is not one of the codes above and has no `error` key.
